Summary per parliament

Source: R/context-anchor.R
parliament_summary.Rd

Summarises each parliament and chamber that has sitting days in the database.

Usage

parliament_summary(
  parliament_id = NULL,
  chamber = NULL,
  chamber_venue = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  collect = TRUE,
  limit = NULL
)

Arguments

parliament_id

Filter on the sitting's parliament_id: whole numbers or in_range().

chamber

"house" and/or "senate", in any case.

chamber_venue

Filter on the turn's chamber_venue: whole numbers or in_range().

columns

Character vector of columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per parliament and chamber, ordered by them, and columns parliament_id, chamber, n_sitting_days, n_members, n_turns and mean_words_per_speech. Zero rows if nothing matches; a lazy table (in no set order) if collect = FALSE.

Details

  • n_sitting_days: the sitting days in sittings.

  • n_members: the serving members, the distinct PHIDs with a period of service (parl_service) in the chamber that overlaps the parliament. Service as a Member is the House and as a Senator the Senate. The parliament runs from DateOpening (or DateElection where that is missing) to ParliamentEnd (or DateDissolution where that is missing); with neither end date it is ongoing. A service with no end date is ongoing.

  • n_turns: all turns in v_speech, including presiding-officer and unmatched turns, but not quotes (passages read out), as in member_activity().

  • mean_words_per_speech: words over speeches, with n_words and n_speeches defined as in member_activity() (n_words is computed when the query runs), over all speakers. NA where there are no speeches.

chamber_venue filters the turns only; sitting days and members are not affected by it.

See also

member_activity(), party_activity(), get_parliaments()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
parliament_summary()
#> # A tibble: 8 × 6
#>   parliament_id chamber n_sitting_days n_members n_turns mean_words_per_speech
#>           <int> <chr>            <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl>                 <dbl>
#> 1             1 house                1        22      85                  77.4
#> 2             7 senate               1        14      51                 139. 
#> 3            33 senate               1        30      74                 143. 
#> 4            36 house                1        51     114                 699. 
#> 5            40 house                1        62     102                 711. 
#> 6            40 senate               1        53     150                 474. 
#> 7            46 senate               1        44     246                 304. 
#> 8            47 house                1        67     158                 269. 
parliament_summary(parliament_id = in_range(30, 48), chamber = "senate")
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>   parliament_id chamber n_sitting_days n_members n_turns mean_words_per_speech
#>           <int> <chr>            <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl>                 <dbl>
#> 1            33 senate               1        30      74                  143.
#> 2            40 senate               1        53     150                  474.
#> 3            46 senate               1        44     246                  304.
db_disconnect()
